verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a SaaS identity platform like Auth0, so the axis applies. The pack shows no assistant inside the Auth0 dashboard or product. The AI-related evidence covers an MCP server and CLI Agent Mode, which let external AI tools such as Claude or Cursor manage a tenant, plus Auth for AI Agents building blocks (Token Vault, CIBA, FGA) for securing customers' own agents. These are adjacent capabilities or developer building blocks, not a built-in assistant users can delegate tasks to.
